frozen_threshold.selection_data: Only 100 seed-held-out predictions from the original B100 training roster

selection_rule: Maximum predicted advantage among the 73 accepted interventions in the completed seed52282 run; no counterfactual outcome used for this choice.

label_contract.aggregation: Mean of 450 post-step native SUMO halting counts summed over the eight controlled lanes and divided by eight.
label_contract.first_interval: Request rigid or captured PP action through the unchanged safe executor for ten seconds.
label_contract.continuation: PhasePressure in both branches for the remaining 440 seconds.
label_contract.score_scale: Predicted advantage is group-normalized; compare ordering, not magnitude, against raw branch costs.

execution.prefixes: One ordinary 610-second prefix reference; three fresh 600-second prefixes each hand over directly to a 450-second branch at select, before any action request.
execution.validation: The reference accepted trace matches V154M. Every live prefix decision and target physical state, including pending count, matches that reference exactly. Rigid first ten costs and its repeat 460-element outcome vector match exactly.
execution.safety: All prefix safety and branch collisions/teleports retained; incomplete/unsafe branches never yield a pairwise cost conclusion.
execution.reason_for_v2: V1 full state reload reproduced itself but failed to reproduce original first-ten-second costs (maximum per-lane difference0.625); preserve INVALID and remove reload from scientific branches.

limits: One preselected online decision is a diagnostic, not an estimate of the quality of all accepted actions.
This original-label PP continuation differs from subsequent thresholded closed-loop control.
